TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is a Pakistan-incorporated technology company established in 2012 and registered with SECP, with active FBR NTN/ATL status and Punjab & Sindh sales tax registrations [CO-PROFILE]. We bring an ISO 9001 quality management system and an ISO 27001 information security management system, supported by CMMI Level 3 practices and PMP-certified project managers [CO-PROFILE]. With 250 staff and delivery offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore, and Karachi, we are positioned to implement and sustain PITB’s district-level ICMS with local presence and structured governance [CO-PROFILE].

For PITB’s District Case Management / workflow automation scope, our strongest proof points are successful, high-value government and enterprise deployments that combine secure web platforms, data handling, and operational support. Relevant examples within the last five years include: Cloud Infrastructure for a Federal Government client (PKR 108M, completed 2025) [CAP-012], LMS Development for a Provincial Government client (PKR 102M, completed 2023) [CAP-046], and Cybersecurity for a Provincial Government client (PKR 178M, completed 2021) [CAP-049]. These demonstrate our ability to deliver at the scale and assurance level PITB is seeking.

We will deliver a web-based solution with RBAC, bilingual (English/Urdu) user experience, structured data migration from manual/spreadsheet sources, and three-year maintenance/support aligned to PITB’s SLA and uptime expectations; however, our library does not yet evidence bilingual UI delivery, RBAC implementation details, or an RTO ≤ 4 hours DR commitment, and we will address these explicitly through solution design, DR architecture, and contractual SLAs in our technical proposal.

Mandatory gap: our library does not yet evidence two CISSP (or equivalent) certified data security professionals; we will close this via hiring/partnering and will submit verified certifications with the final team roster.

We will submit complete technical and financial proposals in the required separate sealed envelopes and formats, and we will support PITB through clarification, implementation, training, and long-term operations with disciplined, auditable delivery controls [CO-PROFILE].
